_comment: Numeric parameters for WyckoffSkill and the timing bucket of ICTSkill. Created 2026-09-10 by user decision (knowledge/10-integrated-method.md section 7, decisions 2 and 4). READ THIS FIRST: the 'sourced' block holds numbers the books actually print, with the page citation. The 'project_defined' block holds numbers NO source gives -- knowledge/10 section 7 item 7 records that every Wyckoff source treats 'large volume', 'narrow spread' and 'low-volume Spring' as relative visual judgments. Project-defined numbers must be reported as project parameters, never cited as rules from the book, and are the tuning surface for /improve.

sourced._comment: Every value here has a printed page citation. Do not change these without re-reading the cited page.

st_above_half_tr.meaning: ST[A] above 50% of the TR (AR-SC) reads as supply thinned; below 50% reads as supply still abundant
st_above_half_tr.cite: WA p75, p88 -- knowledge/07 section 5.2 rule WA2-07

st_within_third_of_tr.meaning: the ST-within-one-third-of-the-TR test used in the doi nhan (mislabelling) checks

sot_min_pushes.meaning: minimum pushes before SOT is a valid read
sot_min_pushes.cite: WA p280, p284, p292 -- knowledge/07 section 5.4 rule WA4-52

sot_useful_max_pushes.meaning: 3 to 4 pushes is the useful window; MORE than 4 means the trend is too strong to oppose
sot_useful_max_pushes.cite: WA p280, p284, p292 -- knowledge/07 section 5.4 rule WA4-52

imbalance_ratio_gold_oil_cfd.meaning: Footprint imbalance ratio range for gold and oil CFDs (XAUUSD, XAGUSD, USOIL, UKOIL)

imbalance_ratio_stocks.meaning: Footprint imbalance ratio for high-liquidity equities; crypto must be adjusted per token liquidity, no fixed value is given

value_area_pct.meaning: default Value Area share of traded volume used for VAH/VAL

market_profile_80_rule.meaning: if an attempted breakout of the Value Area fails, price has ~80% chance of reaching the other end of the VA; used for first target

project_defined._comment: NO source gives these. They exist so the deterministic scanner and the model agree on what 'low volume' means. Every output that uses one MUST label it a project parameter. Tune via /improve, never silently.

volume._basis: ratio to the mean volume of the previous lookback_bars completed bars

spread._basis: bar range (high-low) as a ratio to the mean bar range of the previous lookback_bars completed bars

spring_low_volume_max_ratio._basis: a 'low-volume Spring' (WA p80 calls it a good moment to open a partial position) is read as volume at or below this ratio. The book states the concept, not the number.

commitment_bars._basis: 'a period of commitment beyond the TR boundary' (SOS/SOW) is read as at least this many CONSECUTIVE COMPLETED closes beyond the level. The books require time but never quantify it.

same_level_tolerance_atr._basis: the Wyckoff TR boundary and the ICT liquidity level count as THE SAME LEVEL when they are within this multiple of the 20-bar ATR. Drives the mandatory de-duplication check in knowledge/10 section 4.3 and SYSTEM-DESIGN section 6.1.

tick_volume_credit_multiplier._basis: multiplier applied to the Wyckoff effort/volume sub-score when the feed is mt5_bridge_live, where 'volume' is tick count and not traded size (docs/architecture/mt5-bridge.md).

ict._comment: ICT detector parameters. The decks define the concepts, never these numbers (knowledge/04 section 5 and 6: no minimum FVG size, no 'relatively equal' tolerance, no displacement size). Declared here so scanner, drawing layer and backtest agree; every output that uses one labels it a project parameter.

pivot_bars._basis: bars each side for a swing high/low. The deck uses ONE bar each side (knowledge/04 section 2.5, 3. Liquidity p3); 3 is this project's noise filter.

equal_level_tolerance_pct._basis: two swing points count as 'relatively equal' within this percent of the range midpoint (knowledge/04 section 6 item 8: no sourced tolerance).

fvg_min_size_median_ratio._basis: FVGs smaller than this multiple of the median bar range are ignored as noise (knowledge/04 section 5: no minimum size in the source).

displacement._basis: 'displacement is an aggressive move with full-bodied candles' (knowledge/04 section 2.16). Read as: body >= body_min_ratio of the candle range AND range >= range_min_median_ratio x the median bar range of the window. An MSS whose breaking candle fails this is reported as 'close beyond swing without displacement'.

dealing_range._basis: knowledge/04 section 2.18: the range is where buyside and sellside liquidity rest. Anchors = the nearest unswept BSL pool above and SSL pool below the last close; fallback = window extremes (the pre-2026-09-12 behaviour), reported as such.

std_projection_origin._basis: Model11 p20: bullish projection anchors 'low to the previous high which made the highest high'. Origin (fib 0) = the highest pivot high between the last MSS-level swing and the sweep (mirror for shorts); fib 1 = the sweep extreme.

min_rr._basis: '2R is the minimum requirement before taking profit' (knowledge/06 section 3.1 rule 23, Model11 p92). Sourced number, kept here so every consumer reads one value.

timing._comment: Session/killzone scoring caps. The session windows themselves are defined in docs/architecture/session-model.md. These caps are project-defined: knowledge/04 section 6 records that the ICT sources give no killzone rule for crypto or commodity CFDs at all.

min_timeframe_minutes._basis: killzone credit is not awarded below this timeframe. A 1m chart inside a 3h window carries no timing information; the repo's local-read brief already says killzones are meaningless on 1m.
